Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.integrated

Class SupplyCapacityBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.integrated.SupplyCapacityBalance
public final class SupplyCapacityBalance extends Object
Finds the facility pressure that maximises the rate of a supply-limited, capacity-limited system.

A gas system delivers more as the back-pressure (separator or compressor suction pressure) falls, while the compression facility can handle less because the same suction duty needs more power. The best operating pressure is where the two curves cross. This class solves that crossing by bisection and reports which side binds, which is the value-chain question "is production limited by the reservoir and wells, or by the facility?".

  • Method Details

    • maximiseRate

      public static SupplyCapacityBalance.Result maximiseRate(DoubleUnaryOperator supplyAtPressure, DoubleUnaryOperator capacityAtPressure, double minPressureBara, double maxPressureBara)
      Maximises min(supply(p), capacity(p)) over a pressure window.

      If supply is below capacity even at the lowest pressure, the wells limit the rate (SupplyCapacityBalance.Binding.SUPPLY, reported at the minimum pressure). Otherwise the facility limits it: at the maximum pressure if capacity never catches up, or at the interior crossing where both curves meet.

      Parameters:
      supplyAtPressure - deliverable rate at facility pressure; non-increasing in pressure
      capacityAtPressure - facility capacity at the same pressure; non-decreasing in pressure
      minPressureBara - lowest allowed pressure in bara
      maxPressureBara - highest allowed pressure in bara
      Returns:
      operating pressure, rate and binding side
